Balls are connected if they have the same color and the same numbers! The difficulty is that the balls will be attracted to each other and if they cross the white line, the game will start over! Become the first on the leaderboard! Show your record to your friends and colleagues to surprise them! Fight for first place on the leaderboard and prove that you are the winner!
